note: Shared federation lists and tools/services communities use for federation decisions. Covers ActivityPub (Mastodon, Pleroma, etc.) and AT Protocol (Bluesky). All items marked accepted — URLs and maintenance status should be verified before use.

items.label: Anti-Meta Fedipact
items.description: List of ActivityPub instances that publicly committed to defederating from Meta's Threads platform.

items.label: Blacksky
items.description: AT Protocol moderation labeling service focused on protecting Black users from harassment and coordinated targeting.

items.label: FediBlock
items.description: Community convention and aggregation effort for sharing instance block recommendations, organized around the #FediBlock hashtag.

items.label: Fedicheck
items.description: Web tool that compares an instance's blocklist against multiple community blocklist sources to surface gaps in coverage.

items.label: Fediseer
items.description: Reputation and endorsement service where instance admins can vouch for or censure other instances across the Fediverse.

items.label: Garden Fence
items.description: Blocklist of ActivityPub instances maintained to protect communities from harassment and bad-faith actors.

items.label: IFTAS DNIF
items.description: Do Not Interact Federation blocklist maintained by IFTAS for instances with verified severe content policy violations.

items.label: Mastodon Spam Stopper
items.description: Blocklist and automation rules targeting spam accounts and instances on Mastodon.

items.label: Oliphant Unified Blocklist
items.description: Tiered blocklist compiled from multiple Mastodon instance admin sources, graded 0–3 by severity of harm.

items.label: Seirdy Instance Blocklist
items.description: Granular instance blocklist maintained by a Fediverse admin with per-entry rationale and severity tiers.

items.label: The Bad Space
items.description: Index of ActivityPub instances flagged for hosting harassment, hate speech, or insufficient moderation, maintained by a Black-led team.
